dog.description_text:
AGE / WEIGHT: 1 year old / 48 lbs

GENDER: Male

ENERGY: Moderate to Active

GOOD WITH: Dogs - Yes, Kids - Yes, Cats - TBD

ABOUT ME: Hi, I’m new here! My full introduction is on its way.

MY FOSTER SAYS: My story is still being written. Check back soon for updates!

HISTORY

Johnny BARKman came into rescue in Selma, Alabama, as an older puppy along with his sister; his full history is unknown. He traveled to Brooklyn in early October 2026 and is boarding outside the city while we work on finding him a foster home.

DETAILED PROFILE

We will provide a more detailed profile for Johnny once we get to know more about him!

MEDICAL HISTORY

The dogs in our care are up-to-date on vaccinations, spayed or neutered (when old enough), microchipped, and given a general health check. Immediate medical needs and medical history will be addressed with the adopter prior to adoption. Complete vet records will be sent shortly after adoption.
dog.name: JOHNNY BARKMAN
